theme: 教材字彙・進階 650–750 第 42 群

items.pos: v. 解決；解答
items.colloc: solve a problem 解決問題 | solve a mystery 解開謎團
items.distinct: resolve 決心；解決困難問題 | settle 解決爭議
ex: We need to solve this technical issue immediately.
我們必須立即解決這個技術問題。
The manager proposed a way to solve the conflict.
經理提出了解決衝突的方法。
Can you help me solve this complex billing error?
你能幫我解決這個複雜的帳單錯誤嗎？

items.pos: adv. 有點；稍微
items.colloc: somewhat disappointed 有點失望 | somewhat surprised 有點驚訝
items.distinct: somehow 以某種方式 | somewhat 程度副詞
ex: The quarterly report is somewhat confusing to read.
這份季度報告讀起來有點令人困惑。
Our sales figures are somewhat lower than expected.
我們的銷售數據比預期稍微低了一些。
Management seems somewhat hesitant to approve the budget.
管理層似乎對批准預算有點猶豫。

items.pos: n. 演講；言詞
items.colloc: give a speech 發表演講 | opening speech 開幕演講
items.distinct: lecture 學術講座 | talk 非正式談話
ex: The CEO gave an inspiring speech at the conference.
執行長在會議上發表了鼓舞人心的演講。
Her opening speech set the tone for the event.
她的開幕致詞為活動定下了基調。
Please prepare a short speech for the award ceremony.
請為頒獎典禮準備一段簡短的致詞。

items.pos: v. 拼字；意味著 | n. 一段時間
items.colloc: spell out 詳述；清楚說明 | spell check 拼字檢查
items.distinct: spill 灑出 | swell 腫脹
ex: Could you please spell your last name for me?
可以請您為我拼寫一下您的姓氏嗎？
Strict regulations often spell disaster for small businesses.
嚴格的法規通常意味著小型企業的災難。
The new policy spells trouble for our current workflow.
新政策對我們目前的工作流程意味著麻煩。

items.pos: adj. 嚴格的；嚴謹的
items.colloc: strict rule 嚴格規定 | strict budget 嚴格的預算
items.distinct: severe 嚴重的；苛刻的 | harsh 刺耳的；嚴厲的
ex: The company enforces strict safety rules at the factory.
公司在工廠執行嚴格的安全規定。
We are under strict instructions to keep this confidential.
我們接到嚴格指示要對此事保密。
Management maintains a strict policy against workplace harassment.
管理層維持禁止職場騷擾的嚴格政策。

items.pos: n. 表面；外表 | v. 浮現
items.colloc: on the surface 從表面看 | smooth surface 光滑表面
items.distinct: appearance 外貌 | layer 層次
ex: New information surfaced during the final audit process.
在最後審計過程中浮現了新的資訊。
Clean the desk surface before placing the equipment down.
放置設備前請先清潔桌面表面。
These issues only surfaced after the project launch.
這些問題直到專案啟動後才浮現出來。

items.pos: n. 開關；轉換 | v. 轉換；交換
items.colloc: switch sides 轉換立場 | switch to a new plan 換成新方案
items.distinct: shift 移動；變動 | change 改變
ex: We decided to switch to a more reliable supplier.
我們決定轉換到更可靠的供應商。
Please flip the switch to turn on the machine.
請按開關以啟動機器。
He wants to switch his shift with a colleague.
他想要跟同事交換輪班時段。

items.pos: n. 任務；工作 | v. 指派任務
items.colloc: complete a task 完成任務 | assigned task 被指派的任務
items.distinct: duty 職責；義務 | chore 雜務
ex: I have several urgent tasks to finish by today.
我有幾項緊急任務要在今天完成。
The assistant was tasked with organizing the files.
助理被指派負責整理檔案。
Each team member is responsible for their own task.
每位團隊成員都對自己的任務負責。

items.pos: n. 味道；品味 | v. 品嚐；嚐起來
items.colloc: good taste 有品味 | taste test 試吃
items.distinct: flavor 風味 | sense of taste 味覺
ex: The product design reflects the company's refined taste.
產品設計反映了公司高雅的品味。
Clients were invited to taste the new menu items.
客戶受邀品嚐新菜單上的餐點。
This coffee has a unique and pleasant bitter taste.
這咖啡有一種獨特且宜人的苦味。

items.pos: adj. 緊的；拮据的 | adv. 緊緊地
items.colloc: tight budget 預算吃緊 | tight schedule 時間緊湊
items.distinct: tense 緊張的 | firm 堅固的
ex: We are working on a very tight schedule this month.
我們這個月的工作時間非常緊湊。
The company is operating on a tight budget recently.
公司最近的預算運作非常吃緊。
Ensure the bolts are screwed in nice and tight.
確保螺栓被旋得又緊又好。

items.pos: n. 工具；手段
items.colloc: marketing tool 行銷工具 | powerful tool 強大的工具
items.distinct: instrument 儀器；樂器 | device 裝置
ex: Data analysis is a vital tool for business growth.
數據分析是企業成長的重要工具。
They used specialized tools to repair the mainframe.
他們使用專業工具來維修主機。
Software tools can significantly improve your daily productivity.
軟體工具能顯著提升你的日常生產力。

items.pos: n. 貿易；交易
items.colloc: trading company 貿易公司 | international trading 國際貿易
items.distinct: commerce 商業；通商 | business 生意
ex: The trading company specializes in importing raw materials.
這家貿易公司專門進口原物料。
Global trading volume has increased significantly this quarter.
本季全球貿易量顯著增加。
He works in the stock trading department downtown.
他在市中心的股票交易部門工作。

items.pos: adv. 真實地；真正地
items.colloc: truly grateful 非常感謝 | truly impressive 真正令人印象深刻
items.distinct: really 真的 | honestly 誠實地
ex: We are truly sorry for the inconvenience caused today.
我們對今天造成的不便深感抱歉。
It was a truly productive meeting for everyone involved.
對所有參與者來說，這是一場真正有成效的會議。
She is truly dedicated to her professional development.
她真正致力於自己的專業發展。

items.pos: adj. 地下的 | n. 地鐵 | adv. 在地下
items.colloc: underground parking 地下停車場 | take the underground 搭乘地鐵
items.distinct: subway 地鐵（美） | metro 地鐵（歐）
ex: The office building has three floors of underground parking.
這棟辦公大樓有三層地下停車場。
Most of the utility lines are buried underground.
大部分的公用管線都埋在地下。
We took the underground to reach the city center.
我們搭乘地鐵前往市中心。

items.pos: prep. 不像；和...不同 | adj. 不同的
items.colloc: unlike previous years 不像往年 | unlike others 不像其他人
items.distinct: dislike 不喜歡 | likely 可能的
ex: Unlike his predecessor, the new manager prefers emails.
不像前任，這位新經理比較喜歡電子郵件。
The product is unlike anything currently on the market.
這個產品與目前市面上的任何東西都不同。
Unlike last quarter, our sales exceeded all targets.
不像上一季，我們這次的銷售超過了所有目標。

items.pos: adj. 通常的；慣常的
items.colloc: as usual 如往常一樣 | business as usual 照常營業
items.distinct: regular 定期的；規律的 | common 常見的
ex: The meeting finished later than the usual time.
會議比平常的時間更晚結束。
She arrived at the office at the usual hour.
她於平常的時間抵達辦公室。
Despite the crisis, it was business as usual today.
儘管有危機，今天依然照常營業。

items.pos: v. 拜訪；參觀 | n. 訪問；參觀
items.colloc: business visit 商務拜訪 | official visit 正式訪問
items.distinct: tour 巡迴參觀 | attend 出席
ex: The client will visit our factory next Tuesday.
客戶下週二將會參觀我們的工廠。
We are planning a visit to the regional office.
我們正計畫前往區域辦公室拜訪。
Thank you for taking the time to visit us.
感謝您撥冗前來拜訪我們。

items.pos: adj. 每週的 | adv. 每週地 | n. 週刊
items.colloc: weekly meeting 每週會議 | weekly report 週報
items.distinct: monthly 每月的 | daily 每日的
ex: We hold a weekly meeting to discuss project updates.
我們每週召開會議討論專案進度。
Please submit your weekly report by Friday afternoon.
請在週五下午前提交您的週報。
The team receives a weekly update from the director.
團隊每週都會收到主任的最新消息。

items.pos: n. 機場
items.colloc: international airport 國際機場 | airport shuttle 機場接駁車
items.distinct: airfield 飛機場 | terminal 航廈
ex: The taxi dropped me off at the airport entrance.
計程車在機場入口處讓我下車。
We need to leave early to arrive at the airport.
我們需要早點出發才能抵達機場。
The airport security check was very efficient today.
今天機場的安全檢查非常有效率。

items.pos: n. 基礎；根據
items.colloc: on a daily basis 每天 | on a regular basis 定期地
items.distinct: foundation 地基；基礎 | principle 原則
ex: We communicate with the client on a daily basis.
我們與客戶保持每日溝通。
These figures serve as the basis for our proposal.
這些數據是我們提案的基礎。
The agreement provides a solid basis for our partnership.
該協議為我們的合作提供了堅實的基礎。
